payload.title: Privacy, gold eval, and release readiness
payload.description:
Purpose: prove the privacy guarantees, validate counting accuracy against gold labels, and make the feature release-ready.

Scope: a static unit test asserting no network-capable imports under src/sentiment/**; tests asserting output and scan state contain no verbatim message text; a lint guard preventing real transcripts from being committed under tests/fixtures/sentiment/; one gold-labeling annotation pass over the fixture corpus (labels: thanks, fbomb, both, neither, excluded) with contested labels filed as findings (proposed until a person accepts); accuracy gates (exact match on synthetic fixtures; human-message recall sampled on Ryan's real Macs, aggregate numbers only) and paste-heuristic threshold tuning from the real corpus; docs (README section, wiki page, engines note if bumped).

Done when: privacy tests are green in CI; the accuracy thresholds are met and recorded; the labeling pass and findings exist in Kanbus; docs are updated; the feature is release-ready per the repo's conventional-commit and semantic-release flow.
